It also leans on the unmatched note-check figures (43%, 20%, 10%) with no grounding in the card.","problems":["Note-check percentages (problems 43%, data 20%, bulk created 10%, paste heavy 13%, late 17%) are not on the evidence card; the script could not match 10, 20, 43. They may come from tool output, but the packet does not show them.","Rationale cites C0035778 and C0035785 as bulk-created/paste-heavy notes; C0035785 does not appear on the card at all, and C0035778 is only a low-complexity AF claim with no documentation shown. These are unsupported.","Says 'back pain, abdominal pain and rash' dominate the low-complexity sample; the card shows R21 (rash) but also other dx, so it is loosely grounded. The cited C0035920 is R21 and is fine, but the 'dominated' claim is thin.","Claims 'several notes record high MDM' for 0/1-condition visits and cites C0035946, C0035994 and C0035895; these are supported by the card. However, C0035994 has Z09 with 53 minutes recorded, which contradicts 'most supported examples have no recorded minutes' only partially (3 of 4 lack minutes, so fine).","Headline says 'in every complexity band', but the 4-condition band share (0.235) and 5+ band are not clearly above expectation in the same way; the 5+ band has n=2. It is overstated.","The rationale is long and speculative about 'inflated notes' from the cloned-documentation signals; the cited claims in the example list (C0035831, C0035757, C0035769) do not support the cloning point.","Comparison '3% for the comparison providers' matches the card's all_provider_rate 0.034, but 9% vs 3% is described as 'close to the comparison rate', which is inaccurate."]}
